title: Athing Mu-Nikolayev Splits From Coach Bobby Kersee
excerpt: Olympic 800m champion Athing Mu-Nikolayev and coach Bobby Kersee have ended their three-year partnership. What a coaching change can mean for you.
body:
Athing Mu-Nikolayev, the 2021 Olympic and 2022 world 800m champion, has ended her coaching partnership with Bobby Kersee after about three years. Kersee confirmed the split to LetsRun in December 2025 and described it as a personal decision. Mu-Nikolayev had told him in September, and she and her husband have moved from Los Angeles to Dallas. Her new coach had not been announced when the split was reported.

Elite athletes change coaches when their needs change, and it is not a sign of failure on either side. The same applies to recreational runners: a plan, group or coach that suited you two years ago may not fit your goals or life now.

Once a season, honestly assess whether your training structure still fits what you want. If it feels stale or misaligned, change one thing, such as your plan, your training partners or your coach, rather than giving up on the goal.

Source: LetsRun.com
keyTakeaway: Reassess whether your training structure still fits your goals; changing it is not a failure.
